name: Copy.ai
tagline: Copy.ai is an AI writing tool that generates marketing copy, email sequences, social captions, product descriptions, and sales scripts from short prompts. Its library of 90+ templates covers virtually every marketing content type, and a built-in workflow engine lets teams automate repetitive copy production. It's one of the fastest tools for going from brief to first draft.
